description:
• About our brand and products: TKO Lab is redefining modern wellness through a new kind of ritual-premium hemp tea enriched with THC-A and naturally occurring CBD. Backed by strict UK compliance and precision testing, all products contain <0.2% Δ9-THC and are non-psychoactive when prepared as directed.


• What makes us different: Most brands stop at CBD. We go further. TKO Lab introduces THCA into the conversation - an often overlooked cannabinoid that works alongside CBD to elevate the product, without the high.


• How affiliates can earn: We built our affiliate programme to reward those who genuinely move culture and influence decisions. 

  • Earn commission on ever sale through your unique referral link
  • Track performamce and earnings in real time
  • Unlock bonuses through high-performing content and referrals
  • Opportunity for early access to new product drops and limited releases

• How to promote us: TKO Lab performs best when it feels real, not forced. 

We encourage affiliates to:

  • Create lifestyle-led content
  • Show authentic use
  • Speak to your audience in your own voice (no scripted energy)
  • Lean into storytelling

These Terms and Conditions (“Agreement”) govern your participation in the TKO LAB Affiliate Program (“Program”). By joining or participating in the Program, you agree to be bound by the following terms. If you do not agree, please do not participate.

1. Eligibility

To participate, you must be at least 18 years of age and operate a legitimate website, social media account, or marketing platform. TKO LAB reserves the right to accept or reject any application at its sole discretion and for any reason.

2. Commission Structure

  • Commission Type: Percent of sale

  • Commission Rate: 10% of the total sale amount (excluding taxes, shipping, and discounts).

  • Cookie Duration: 30 days from the customer’s first click on your affiliate link.

  • If a customer completes a purchase through your affiliate link or using your assigned coupon code, you will earn a 10% commission.

  • Only sales tracked and verified through TKO LAB’s affiliate system are eligible for commission.

3. Payment

  • Commissions will be paid only for valid, completed, and non-refunded orders.

  • Payments are made once your accumulated balance reaches the minimum payout threshold set by TKO LAB.

  • All payments are made via the method specified in your affiliate dashboard.

  • TKO LAB reserves the right to withhold or adjust commissions in cases of cancellations, chargebacks, or suspected fraud.

4. Prohibited Activities

You must not:

  • Use your affiliate link or coupon code for self-purchases or orders made on behalf of others.

  • Engage in spam, paid traffic fraud, or misleading advertising.

  • Use coupon sites, cashback sites, or unauthorized third-party platforms unless expressly approved by TKO LAB.

  • Promote TKO LAB in a way that could harm our reputation, including false claims or inappropriate content.

  • Use TKO LAB’s trademarks, brand name, or logos in domains, advertising, or social media handles without written permission.

Violation of any of these rules may result in immediate termination of your affiliate account and forfeiture of any pending commissions.

5. Tracking and Attribution

  • The Program uses cookies to track referrals.

  • Cookies remain valid for 30 days unless cleared by the user.

  • If multiple affiliates refer the same customer, the commission is credited to the most recent valid referral.

6. Modification and Termination

  • TKO LAB may modify these terms, the commission rate, or any part of the Program at any time without prior notice.

  • TKO LAB reserves the right to terminate your participation in the Program at any time, with or without cause, and to withhold unpaid commissions if fraudulent or abusive activity is suspected.

  • TKO LAB shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising in connection with the Program.

  • Participation in the Program does not create any employment, agency, or partnership relationship between you and TKO LAB.

his Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of United Kingdom without regard to conflict of law principles.

9. Acceptance

By joining or continuing to participate in the TKO LAB Affiliate Program, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to these Terms and Conditions.
